policies.title: Volume purchase discount
policies.source: For VIP bulk, wholesale and high-volume quantity orders, including qualified large purchases, case-lot orders and pallet orders, customers may receive up to a 10% quantity discount. The structured direct limit is 10%.

policies.title: Repeat customer loyalty discount
policies.source: For returning VIP accounts with a long-standing customer relationship, loyalty rebates up to 5% may be granted directly. Repeat-buyer rewards, loyal member renewals and retention requests above 5% and up to 8% require manager review.

policies.title: Early payment concession
policies.source: VIP customers who prepay, make an upfront or advance payment, pay cash, promptly settle the invoice or clear it within seven days may receive an early-payment concession up to 7%. The direct limit is 7%.

policies.title: Seasonal campaign offer
policies.source: During approved seasonal, holiday, spring, summer, year-end, festive event or campaign offers, VIP customers may receive a 6% promotion directly. A seasonal offer above 6% and up to 9% requires manager review.

policies.title: Product category promotion
policies.source: Selected Product A catalog items in the designated product category, series, model, product line or product-specific range may receive a category promotion up to 4%. The direct product-specific discount limit is 4%.
